title.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS
title.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS

summary.ja: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。
summary.en: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1変数、対称Gaussianランダムウォーク提案幅1.5。固定master seedから32の別PCG64ストリームを生成し、1024回のburn-in後に各8192標本を保持します。
assumptions.en: One dimensionless variable and symmetric Gaussian random-walk width1.5. Spawn 32 separate PCG64 streams from a fixed master seed; retain 8192 samples per chain after 1024 burn-in steps.

algorithm.ja: log受理比でMetropolis更新。FFTによる連鎖内自己共分散を平均し、Geyerのgamma0+gamma1から始まる初期正ペア和から平均観測量のESSを求めます。古典的split-Rhatも併記します。
algorithm.en: Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat.

validation.ja: 正規CDFを独立参照とし、標本数1024/2048/8192の連鎖平均RMSEを比較。別の定常AR(1)系列と厳密tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho)で診断量を照合します。公差は固定入力で事前指定します。
validation.en: Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs.

limits.ja: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。
limits.en: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate.

review.en: Publisher-side abstract/metadata and returned original-paper excerpts on initial-positive sequences and AR(1), from a university-hosted copy, checked. No full-text audit or convergence certificate for arbitrary chains is claimed.
